Chronicles Of The Sinner
games.summary: Chronicles of The Sinner is a first-person survival horror set inside an abandoned orphanage. As a lone investigator, you are sent to uncover what happened within its walls. Explore, gather resources, solve puzzles, and try to survive… if you don’t lose yourself first.

games.name: Crimson Desert Enhanced: Charting the Unknown
Croc 2 Kingdom of the Gobbos
games.summary: Croc's back, and this time he's searching for his long-lost parents. Revived by the Dantinis, arch enemy Baron Dante vows revenge. Explore four mainland villages, rescue Gobbos, and battle new Guardians. Race cars and speedboats, ride minecarts, and take to the skies in the remastered 1999 classic.

games.name: Curse of Resthaven
games.summary:
Resthaven is cursed. Your niece has vanished. And in seven days, the island will be destroyed.

Curse of Resthaven is a single-player narrative roguelite where investigation, town management, trading, deck building, and branching expeditions combine into a dark mystery of survival and consequence.

Take command of the cursed island colony of Resthaven after your niece disappears on the eve of catastrophe. Govern the town, interrogate suspicious locals, trade with visiting merchants, upgrade vital businesses, and decide who — or what — to trust as the island’s secrets begin to surface.

Beyond the safety of Resthaven’s walls, you will send card-driven expeditions into the island’s wilderness. Build a deck of resource and companion cards, choose who to bring, decide what to carry, and prepare for unpredictable encounters with eldritch horrors.

The cataclysm comes in just seven days. When destruction strikes, the island’s fading guardian intervenes, sending you back to the moment of your arrival with your memories and experience intact. Each loop offers new knowledge, permanent upgrades, and dangerous blessings from the island’s goddess — but every advantage may come with a cost.

Every loop reveals new truths about Resthaven, the forces seeking to control the island’s power, and your niece’s role in what is unfolding. Interrogate over 25 fully voiced characters, uncover their motives and secrets, and piece together a mystery shaped by mythology, history, and cosmic dread.

With multiple major narrative paths and randomized expeditions, every playthrough exposes different pieces of the puzzle. Only by mastering the town, surviving the island, and understanding the time loop can you hope to break the curse.

games.name: Cyber Neon: Core Protocol
games.summary: Crimson Crawl is a dark fantasy pixel-art roguelike RPG that combines dungeon exploration, deckbuilding, and turn-based horde battles. Buil blood-themed card synergies, conquer endless swarms of enemies, and descend into ever-changing labyrinths where every run offers new challenges and rewards.

games.name: Dark Lots
games.summary: Dark Lots is a first-person survival horror game where noise draws blind, faceless creatures and black water turns people into monsters. Explore a settlement, scavenge supplies, treat wounds, manually reload weapons, and build a shelter.

games.name: Dead Ringer
games.summary: It begins with a phone plugged into a faulty socket and an electric malfunction, it ends with seven dead and one missing... Detective Maxwell Morgan must navigate the testimonies of both the living and the dead to find a murderer before it's too late, in this Murder Mystery Visual Novel.

games.name: Digital Romance Memoir
games.summary: A fully immersive kinetic novel: boot a PC running Prisma OS and descend into the psyche of a broken protagonist as 2001 Argentina collapses in the background. Late-night chats, obsession, music and raw Y2K grit, until one decision changes everything.

games.name: E-Files
games.summary: E-FILES — a psychological horror game in the style of the PS1 era, centered around a secret investigation, rituals, and the mysterious “Lists.” Explore dark locations, search for clues, solve puzzles, and avoid deadly traps. Fixed camera angles, retro graphics, and limited saves.

games.summary: A co-op puzzle game for groups of friends: 50 levels, each with its own rules. Grab and throw anything — including your friends — talk things through over voice chat, and figure out solutions that are almost never obvious.

games.name: GO DUB YOURSELF!
games.summary: Grab a mic and dub over your favourite clips with your friends. Turn any video into a clip pack, share it on the workshop, then battle it out on the couch or online for up to 12 players. Auto score or judge each other, the choice is yours!

games.name: God's Favourite Monster
games.summary: In this Action RPG, fight through a deadly labyrinth filled with a variety of enemies, puzzles, and traps. Take the form of defeated enemies and use their abilities as your own! Do you have what it takes to survive?

games.name: GOOB8

games.name: Hauntasy
games.summary: Do you believe in ghosts? A wealthy baron offers you $1,000,000 to take part in the Hauntasy, a seven-night challenge inside his family's supposedly haunted estate. Keep watch, manage your limited resources, and survive until dawn to claim the reward.

games.name: Heir of the Dog
games.summary:
From the creators of Lucy Dreaming comes Heir of the Dog, a hilariously British pixel-art point & click adventure set in dark, Victorian London.

After drinking his uncle's secret formula, Cummerbund Bandersnatch undergoes a monsterous transformation. Solve intriguing puzzles, manipulate time, find love and uncover the truth behind London's most secret society as you help Bandersnatch regain his humanity.

games.name: Hokko Spaces
games.summary: Hokko Spaces is a calm, casual sandbox that gives you fun tools to create beautiful, lively spaces inhabited by adorable characters. Unlock cute residents and watch them hang out, do some gardening, and enjoy the spaces you build for them. No rules, no stress, just cozy dioramas and chill vibes.

games.name: Hunting Simulator 3
games.summary:
This open-world game lets you experience the thrill of the hunt, with your faithful dog or fellow hunters by your side! Choose your equipment from official brands, and explore the wilderness in search of your next game.

Either on foot or behind the wheel of your all-terrain vehicle, explore this open world's stunning environments.

In these ever-changing ecosystems, each animal reacts to what you do, each individual ages over time, can reproduce and exhibits true-to-life behaviour thanks to our unique “SimFauna” system.

Kit yourself out with one of the official weapons and other items, to hunt the way you want.

games.name: I Was Reincarnated with the [Idle] Skill, and Now I Do Nothing Demo
Joe & Mac Retro Collection
games.summary:
Developed by Red Art Studios, Red Art Games' internal development studio, the Joe & Mac Retro Collection is a compilation of Joe & Mac: Caveman Ninja, Congo's Caper, and Joe & Mac 2: Lost in the Tropics, the three Joe & Mac titles developed by Data East and released on Super Nintendo between 1991 and 1995. 

In addition to allowing players to rediscover the original games as they were presented back in the 90s, the Joe & Mac Retro Collection also features numerous quality of life improvements!

games.name: Lethal Justice
games.summary: Train your brain playing Italian Checkers on the beautiful wooden board. Fight with your friends on a network at work or at home. Feel the power of artificial intelligence at different levels of difficulty and show yours! FEATURES IN THE GAME ? Play against a computer. ? Play with a friend on the same device. ? Undo move in the single-player mode. ? Play on a local network. ? Play with friends in the Game Center. ? Text messaging on the network. ? Sweet sounds of knocking piece. ? Beautiful professional graphics. ? A little surprise if you win. RULES IN THE GAME Italian Checkers - jumping is mandatory and cannot be passed up to make a non-jumping move, kings can jump backwards, men cannot jump over kings. More detailed description of the rules can be found in the information section (the round button in the main menu).

games.name: Love: Fall in Death
games.summary:
Three men at a bar. One bet. One Kutay - who would do absolutely anything to charm a woman he just met.

Her name is Ayşil. Magnetic, mysterious - her questions are unsettlingly precise. She knows things she shouldn't. Her smile feels ancient.

What begins as a flirtatious dare spirals into a night of unexpected allies, buried secrets, and dangers in Istanbul's shadows. Your choices, timing, and the roll of the dice guide Kutay through romance - or ruin.

games.name: Mining Days
games.summary: Step into a peaceful low-poly mining world and build your own growing mining operation! Start with a simple pickaxe, break rocks, discover valuable ores, hire different types of workers and watch your small site transform into a productive automated bussiness.

games.name: Pardon My French Toast
games.summary: Pardon My French Toast is a 3D platformer starring a slice of toast who covers himself in sweet spreads to get fun abilities.

games.name: Planted!
games.summary:
Planted! is a co-op party game that pits 1-4 players into head-to-head, horticultural combat that will require you to Sow, Grow and Throw your way to victory.  

Part harvest sim, part sports game, and 100% cultivated chaos, Planted! challenges players to take on their friends in arena combat where they will need to strategically plan their produce production for success. Will they utilise fertiliser to grow colossal crops for more points, will they steal their opponents offerings, or will they use powerups to propel themselves to victory? Only thyme will tell. 

Jump in to multiplayer (Online or offline!) chaos with friends all whilst reeking havoc across 8 diverse biomes. Multiplayer not for you? Then put your green thumbs to the test and take on the hand crafted single-player story campaign and enter the world of competitive gardening! Who knew there were so many ways to garden?!?

games.name: PODYEZD 8
games.summary: Floor after floor, you descend, trying to escape the building that refuses to let you go. As you go down, note the details: what's changed: a door, a notice, a neighbor who wasn't there, what's happening outside the window on the street. Miss the anomaly, and the descent will start over.

games.name: Russpuppy Play & Learn
games.summary: A fun collection of learning games for young children. Practice letters, phonics, counting, shapes, and colors with cheerful music, sound effects, and no game-over screens.

games.name: S.O.N.A.R. - Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready
Shot Up: Turtle Gun Jump
games.summary: Jump endlessly upward and ride your gun's recoil to soar even higher! Choose from 4 weapons, combine powerful augmentations to craft your build, and survive monsters and hazards as long as you can. An action platformer where no two runs are the same.

games.name: SLOW ORBIT: Idle Planet Conquest
games.summary: Bilder der Welt ist ein spannendes Bilderquiz mit fantastischen Fotos von den schönsten, wichtigsten und bekanntesten Plätzen der Welt. Außerdem gibt es noch ein paar Hintergrundinformationen im Spiel.

games.name: Soul Finders
games.summary: Soul Finders is a supernatural multiplayer party game. Collect souls, feed a Witch's Tree, or survive the hunt. Compete solo or team up in three distinct game modes built for chaos, competition, and Halloween fun.

games.name: Stellar Abyss
games.summary: Stellar Abyss is an online space sandbox. Command and customize your ship as you explore, fight, mine, manufacture, and trade between star systems. Take on contracts alone or join a fleet for rescue and escort missions. Start with a small ship and find your next opportunity among the stars.

games.name: Super Egg & TCG Card Shop Simulator: Prologue
TAKTAKTOP
games.summary: TakTakTop is a fast-paced multiplayer battle royale set in a world of ever-changing floating platforms. Boost and fly through the sky, blast rivals with energy missiles, disguise as props, and race to the escape goal — climb higher and be the last one standing at the top.

games.name: Tales of the Immortal Path
games.summary: One sword breaks all arts, one thought attains immortality. Tales of the Immortal Path is an ink-wash xianxia single-player card roguelike. Countless artifacts and cards. Trample the heavens and seek the Dao of immortality!

games.name: Terminal Closure
games.summary: Take your place at the tactical station of a spaceship and face a brutal war in the near future for control of the outer planets in this realistic space warfare simulator. Choose your side and lead your ship into battle, maneuvering and fighting according to the laws of orbital mechanics.

games.name: Terrible Lizards
games.summary: Terrible Lizards is a horror parkour game set against the backdrop of an old Route 66 attraction… with something dark and sinister lurking below. To escape, you’ll need to move fast, navigate challenging terrain, and uncover what Dalton’s Dinos is really hiding. You’d better start running.

games.name: The Hallways
games.summary: Introducing "Hallways," a multiplayer escape game. Navigate corridors, evade pursuers, and compete with friends or globally. Solo, 2-player, and 4-player modes, with a matchmaking system and private lobbies. Customize characters and gear, employ strategy, and conquer challenging levels in this game.

games.name: The Transference
games.summary: Jump into an escape room set in a deranged mind and experience a first-person exploration game in a chilling new dimension. Shift between three perspectives and attempt to unravel the mystery hiding in this mind-bending psychological thriller. Project yourself into a riveting narrative experience and become immersed in an unsettling psychological thriller. Piece together a family's mystery as you recover fragmented memories from the corrupted consciousness of each perspective. In this first-person narrative mystery, you must explore the walls of the family's home to interpret events and discover the truth. Playable in VR and non-VR modes.

games.name: The Wolf Among Us Remastered
games.summary:
Step back into Fabletown in The Wolf Among Us Remastered - the definitive edition of Telltale’s acclaimed noir narrative thriller inspired by DC’s award-winning Fables comic series.

Critically acclaimed, The Wolf Among Us became one of the most celebrated story-driven adventures of its generation, praised for its unforgettable characters, sharp writing, and meaningful player choice.

Fully remastered with enhanced visuals and modern presentation, this definitive edition brings Bigby Wolf’s first investigation to life with greater atmosphere, immersion, and detail than ever before - honoring the original experience while introducing Fabletown to a new generation of players.

Investigate brutal murders, interrogate suspects, explore crime scenes, and uncover a conspiracy hiding beneath the streets of Fabletown, where myths and legends live secretly among us.

games.name: The Zibbo Show
games.summary:
The lights are on. The audience is going crazy. And tonight, YOU are the star of the show!

Progress through 12 rounds of increasingly dangerous opponents, build a new strategy every run, and face Zibbo himself in the in the grand finale! If you make it that far.

Pick your dice, place your bets, build your combos, and try not to think too hard about what happens when you lose.

games.name: Thumb Hiker
games.summary: Turn your thumbstick movements into a journey. Thumb Hiker runs alongside your games, tracking both sticks as you move, reach landmark milestones, and unlock achievements. Opt into the shared global hike and help the community go further.

games.name: Thump: Tiny Heart Flutters
games.summary: Thump: Tiny Heart Flutters is a casual jigsaw puzzle game. Complete puzzles one after another to uncover the hidden feelings and secrets of the girls hidden in daily trivialities. Here it’s only you, a puzzle, and a girl who’s been waiting for you.

games.name: Usagi Shima: Bunny Island
games.summary:
You've been tasked as caretaker of an abandoned island - as you decorate and rebuild it over time, curious (but adorable!) visitors start to appear...

Usagi Shima is a casual, relaxing bunny collecting game developed with Godot Engine and drawn in Krita.

It is heavily inspired by cute, soothing games like Neko Atsume and Animal Crossing. The game's namesake and setting draws inspiration from Okunoshima, a real island in Japan that has a lot of bunny inhabitants!

Buy toys and and build structures on an abandoned island to entice curious bun tourists to pay you a visit! Discover, take photos, and even befriend a variety of bunnies that visit based on how you've decorated and arranged the island.

games.name: VOIDCAST
games.summary: Explore an abandoned video store after dark and descend into spaces that defy logic, where warnings and guidance blur into one without escape.

games.name: Waveguard
games.summary: A roguelike tower defense where every run reshapes your strategy. Build your team of towers, combine more than 80 artifacts, and explore a pixel-art world while taking on ever tougher challenges and bosses.

games.name: WordCrack
games.summary: A challenging word game with CRT terminal aesthetics. Crack words of increasing length in Gauntlet mode. Compete on Steam leaderboards with seeded runs. Regular mode gives 3 lives; Cracked mode is sudden death.

games.name: World Rock Scissors Paper
games.summary: What if Rock Scissors Paper could be enjoyed for much longer? That simple thought inspired us to create this game. Choose your cards, bet your points, and battle 15 opponents. Use finger counts and card numbers to determine the winner, upgrade your cards, and fight your way to victory.

games.name: Your Way Out
games.summary: Pushed into a manhole, you wake up in the sewers with nothing but a lighter. Scavenge the dark tunnels, sell your finds to Rattus the rat trader, upgrade your gear and find your way out before the flame dies.

games.name: All Those Dungeons In Alva's Head
Before I Turn: Survival Auto Battler
Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares
games.summary: Jump, glide, and outsmart traps in this spooky 3D platformer! Smash obstacles, solve puzzles, and fend off evil spirits to defeat The Dream Master. Collect hidden treasures and restore joy to a world shrouded in darkness!

games.name: Cluttermancer: Tidy Up the Nightmare Alley
DESKTOP CLEANER 98: Tidy Up the Desktop

I’m a Wizard, But I Dig

games.summary: In Pinballoid Crush, classic pinball evolves into an arcade experience with adventure and strategy elements.

Queen's Domain
games.summary:
Queen’s Domain is a retro-fantasy action RPG. Washed up on the shores of the Isle of Neasied, you set out to find your father and uncover the dark heart of this mysterious isle. 

Wield the Legendary Holy Sword Endu to take flight from platform to platform, and discover an interconnected, labyrinthine world where secrets and dangers lurk around every corner. 

Fight action-oriented battles with a classic stamina meter, powerful charge attacks, weapon specific special attacks, and secondary throwing weapons. Level up, accessorize, and choose from a huge catalogue of melee weapons on your quest to fight your way through the hordes of monsters and powerful bosses awaiting you in the darkest depths of the isle. 

Features:

Explore an interconnected island filled with hidden secrets

Lovingly crafted retro-fantasy aesthetic 

Action-combat with a stamina meter, special attacks, throwing weapons & more

Fly across gaps with your Holy Sword – use upgrades to fly further!

Dozens of hours of adventuring and exploration

50+ melee weapons to discover, equip, and upgrade

Use XP to level up, and eat delicious food to further increase your stats

20+ types of secondary throwing weapons allow for varied strategies in combat

Over 100 enemies, mini bosses, and bosses to defeat

games.name: Reshine TCG Cards: Cozy Restoration Demo
Scarlet Beret - Murder at the Orphanage
SPECTR: Rekindle the World - Prism Supporter Pack
SURI: The Seventh Note
games.summary: Feel the beat. SURI: The Seventh Note is a rhythm platformer where you must navigate a beautiful but treacherous world to save your mother's life. Time your jumps, dashes, and tricks to the mystical music around you, and restore not just your mother's health, but the rhythm of the island itself.

games.name: SURI: The Seventh Note - Trials Of Yama DLC
The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem
games.summary:
Everyone from the mischievous Dr. Seuss classic is here. Become smart and steady Sally, energetic wild card Johnny, cause double the trouble as Thing 1 & Thing 2 or be cheerful Little Cat A. And of course, the chaos conductor, The Cat in the Hat and anxiously wise Fish will be there to help, on this zany ride.

Play solo or go against your friends, choosing from two trick-filled game modes. Fancy a game of chase? Then ‘Find the Cat’ will have you turning the house upside down looking for The Cat in the Hat. Or maybe you prefer getting into chaotic challenges? See how quickly you can capture penguins, decorate a cake, and who knows what else in the 18 minigames you can choose from.

But the fun doesn’t stop there, just like The Cat’s hat, it’ll be full of tricks. With varying difficulty levels, long challenges and short, there’s something for everyone.

Get ready for your house to be filled with giggles, groans, and glorious mayhem.

games.name: Underway: Tales Of A Killer Soundtrack
